scope.purpose: consume finalized pfUSDC vault-bridge value and mint governed a651 at the current certified NAV

static_arithmetic.minted_a651_reason: must be derived from the fresh certified NAV numerator, denominator, epoch, and unit scale at fire-time

required_fresh_preconditions.required: Leg1 is committed and proves exactly +10000000 pfUSDC atoms with finalized receipt identities
six validators agree on height, tip, state root, and empty mempool before every signed operation
a651 route is live and carries a fresh certified NAV-reserve packet bound to the current route and proof identifiers
signing fee payer has at least 1000000 PFT atoms before each operation
pfUSDC counted receipt allocation, a651 supply limits, and vault capacity all cover 10000000 settlement atoms
matching-profile service and fleet preflight is green immediately before fire
spend ledger remains consistent with its cap and the packet names any incremental fee or cost class before signature

finality: per-operation transaction hash and accepted receipt
six-way height tip root equality after each certified operation
a651 minted delta exactly equals the certified NAV quote
supply and vault allocation deltas equal their typed operation receipts
post-mint nav_reserve_submit and nav_epoch_finalize bind the settlement value into the a651 reserve packet
required_fire_evidence.stop_rule: Any deviation anywhere: STOP-no-retry. Preserve the last accepted receipt, do not submit a replacement operation, and require a separately authorized resume packet.

command_shape.reason_unavailable: The current default profile has no atomic_swap authority, no current primary-subscription builder, and no CLI subcommand that constructs the required receipt-count/allocation/nav_mint_at_nav/reserve-finalize sequence.
forbidden_substitutes: wallet swap --mode transparent --pair pfusdc->a651: requires absent atomic_swap authority and is a dual-wallet DvP swap, not governed primary issue
wallet get-navcoin: direct issuer-issued a651 transfer and does not consume pfUSDC vault-bridge value

missing_surfaces.missing: No stakehub.cli subcommand constructs the six-operation governed primary subscription sequence for the default profile.
evidence: StakeHub-repeat-demo/stakehub/cli.py:243-320 exposes wallet commands but no primary-subscription command
StakeHub-repeat-demo/stakehub/cli.py:883-939 dispatches wallet-demo commands; transparent-navswap loads atomic_swap rather than the primary subscription sequence
StakeHub-repeat-demo/docs/pfusdc-bridge-runbook.md:252-280 names the required six production operations

missing_surfaces.missing: data/wallet-demo-devnet2.json has no atomic_swap object and no typed current primary subscription operation-builder configuration.
evidence: StakeHub-repeat-demo/stakehub/atomic_swap_config.py:147-154 requires atomic_swap and rejects its absence

missing_surfaces.missing: No safe path-only signer interface exists for the current receipt submit, count, allocation, mint, reserve submit, and epoch finalize operations.
evidence: StakeHub-repeat-demo/docs/pfusdc-bridge-runbook.md:261-280 requires normal PFTL quote/sign/submit for each operation
StakeHub-repeat-demo/stakehub/generalized_wallet.py:1111-1205 proves get-navcoin is issuer-only transfer rather than the required signer-separated subscription flow

minimum_safe_implementation.builder: Add one non-mutating current-primary-subscription prepare command that consumes only path-based Leg1 finality evidence and fresh six-validator reads, builds the six typed operation artifacts, records hashes, and refuses absent or stale receipt, route, NAV, capacity, or fee-payer predicates.
minimum_safe_implementation.signers: Take signer file paths only at fire-time; never embed credential values in source, packet, logs, or public evidence.
minimum_safe_implementation.fire: A separate explicitly authorized fire command must quote, sign, submit, and prove finality one typed operation at a time, with no automatic replacement on any failure.
minimum_safe_implementation.post_mint: Require nav_reserve_submit then nav_epoch_finalize in the same held sequence; the a651 reserve proof must include the +1000000000 usd_1e8 settlement value.
